metadata.summary:
Primary question: AMD's market share has significantly grown across key segments over the past six years. In CPUs, AMD's overall x86 market share reached 25.6% in 2021 and 31.1% in 2023, hitting a new record. By Q2 2025, desktop CPU market share rose to 32.2%, a substantial increase from 17.1% in Q2 2019. Server CPU market share dramatically increased, reaching 27.3% in Q2 2025 and even 50% by Q1 2025 in some reports, challenging Intel's dominance. In contrast, AMD's discrete GPU market share has seen recent declines, falling to 6-8% in Q2 2025, despite new product launches.

Industry context: AMD's 2025 outlook is significantly bolstered by its "transformative" multi-billion dollar partnership with OpenAI to supply Instinct GPUs, challenging Nvidia's AI dominance and projecting substantial revenue growth. The company's aggressive MI350 series roadmap

details.sql:
WITH market_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    calendar_quarter_num,
    calendar_quarter,
    SUM(value) AS total_market_revenue
  FROM comp_financials
  WHERE metric = 'Revenue'
    AND ticker IN ('AMD','AVGO','INTC','MU','NVDA','QCOM','TXN')
    AND calendar_quarter_num IS NOT NULL
    AND calendar_year >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int - 6)
  GROUP BY calendar_year, calendar_quarter_num, calendar_quarter
),
amd_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    calendar_quarter_num,
    calendar_quarter,
    SUM(value) AS amd_revenue
  FROM comp_financials
  WHERE metric = 'Revenue'
    AND ticker = 'AMD'
    AND calendar_quarter_num IS NOT NULL
    AND calendar_year >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int - 6)
  GROUP BY calendar_year, calendar_quarter_num, calendar_quarter
)
SELECT
  m.calendar_year,
  m.calendar_quarter_num,
  m.calendar_quarter,
  COALESCE(a.amd_revenue, 0) AS amd_revenue,
  m.total_market_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN m.total_market_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (COALESCE(a.amd_revenue, 0) / m.total_market_revenue) * 100
  END AS market_share_percent
FROM market_revenue m
LEFT JOIN amd_revenue a
  ON m.calendar_year = a.calendar_year
  AND m.calendar_quarter_num = a.calendar_quarter_num
  AND m.calendar_quarter = a.calendar_quarter
ORDER BY m.calendar_year DESC, m.calendar_quarter_num DESC
LIMIT 10000;
